Lines of the Odyssey count too (Homer shares formulae across the two poems): reuse their English unless the Iliad context forbids it, and say so in new-renderings.md when you depart. Where a whole unit of yours has the same Greek as a published Iliad unit, its `l` and `i` must be identical to the published ones (the validator enforces it). Where only a line inside your unit repeats, reuse the published wording for that line as far as your sentence allows.
